subject: reasoning
question:
Based on the English alphabetical order, three of the following four letter-cluster pairs are alike in a certain way and thus form a group. Which letter-cluster pair DOES NOT belong to that group?

(Note: The odd one out is not based on the number of consonants/vowels or their position in the letter-cluster.)
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/47fc55d1448a4e304a2615e2edcf078e2c0d6f8d74bc2a848a79ef83d6e78800.png] 

The logic followed here is:

Option 1) LG-JN

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7df5ecfa28a79a09f83252168a6a9189e18e9701c2f71fbf6bc2d891b6436139.png] 

Option 2) JE-HL

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d826930d47b60cc0f09cb7dd832b9d8ac333ba6f91c8dc2f4c7af30a62909594.png] 

Option 3) OJ-MQ

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bed4cfb25c1502b86c35d5f9927e62727cba0ad9da68214faed244a0657b58b8.png] 

**Option 4) GB-EJ**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b88c74740acc21d09307890016843ec6cef747c6d5fc5052ad91acdbedfbd38d.png] 

Here, 'GB-EJ' is odd among the given options.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4".
